fields.summary_ko.0: Apple (AAPL) has risen 29% year-to-date and is currently trading at $348.76, with 24/7 Wall St. setting a target price of $403.43 and a BUY rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Apple has achieved 10 consecutive earnings beats and is expected to deliver its best quarter in history in December, though net profit margin is projected to decline from 47.9% to 45–46% due to memory costs.
fields.summary_ko.2: Apple's free cash flow yield is higher than Microsoft (MSFT) and Alphabet (GOOGL), and capital expenditure has fallen 28.9%, justifying premium valuation.
